This small plot of mine is just a little piece, only about half an acre, and I plant beans mixed with other things like I always do. I am an old man now, 68, and my cash is tight — fertilizer coupons from FISP usually go to the maize plot, not to this bean plot. Beans put their own goodness in the soil, my father taught me this, so I do not waste fertilizer on them. I will put some manure from my goats and chickens, use the seed I saved from last harvest, and weed with my own hands and my wife's help.
